steps_video-to-gif_1Desc: Select a video file (MP4, WebM, or MOV) to convert. The video loads in your browser for frame-accurate GIF creation. Maximum file size is 50 MB.
steps_video-to-gif_2Desc: Choose the start time, duration, frame rate, and output dimensions. Lower frame rates and smaller dimensions produce smaller GIF files.
steps_video-to-gif_3Desc: Click Convert to render your video clip as an animated GIF. The resulting GIF is optimized for sharing on social media, messaging apps, and forums.
